test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum on simple interest will a sum of money triple itself in 10 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹X

Amount (A) = ₹3X

Time (t) = 10 years

**Formula used:**

A = P + P × r × t

Where, r = rate

**Calculation:**

3X = X + X × r × 10

⇒ 3X - X = X × r × 10

⇒ 2X = X × r × 10

⇒ r = 2/10

⇒ r = 0.2

⇒ r = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
